$comment: Deployment config for 6036 Scouting. Edit this file, rebuild (or just
redeploy dist/), and every device picks up the same defaults instead of
Anything a scout changes in Settings is stored per-device and overrides
SECURITY: tbaApiKey below is served to anyone who opens the site, even
though the GitHub repo is private -- GitHub Pages sites are public. This
is a deliberate tradeoff so the team never has to type a key. It is a TBA
*read* key: it can only read public FRC data, cannot write anything, and
can be regenerated instantly at thebluealliance.com/account if it is ever
abused. Rotate it there and redeploy to invalidate the old one.
